description: This file defines a PHP trait named ModuleScreenHelperTrait within the OrangeHRM project, which provides a protected method to retrieve the current module and screen information as a ModuleScreen object, by calling a helper method from ModuleScreenHelper.

methods.name: getCurrentModuleAndScreen
methods.description: Protected method that returns the current module and screen information as a ModuleScreen object by delegating the call to ModuleScreenHelper.
